cookie_consent_message: We use cookies to keep you signed in and to improve your experience. We don't use cookies for ads or tracking. By continuing, you agree to our use of cookies — for comprehensive information, please visit our <policyLink>Cookie Policy</policyLink>.
cookie_policy_intro_body: Cookies are small text files a website stores on your device. Let's Live uses a small, fixed set of cookies to keep the site working. We do not use cookies for advertising, tracking, or analytics.
cookie_policy_row_access_purpose: Keeps you signed in and authorizes your requests while you use the site.
cookie_policy_row_access_duration: Set by the server; cleared on logout.
cookie_policy_row_refresh_purpose: Lets the site renew your session without asking you to log in again.
cookie_policy_row_refresh_duration: Set by the server; cleared on logout.
cookie_policy_essential_note: All cookies above are essential — the site cannot authenticate you or remember your language without them, so there is no optional/reject toggle for them.
cookie_policy_control_body: You can delete or block cookies through your browser settings. Blocking the ACCESS_TOKEN or REFRESH_TOKEN cookies will sign you out and prevent you from staying logged in.
cookie_policy_contact_body: Contact us if you have questions about this policy or how we handle cookies.
